note: Set A invents several beam length sums (e.g., 3'-0"+3'-0"+9'-0"+1'-6" for Grid 4, 6'-0"+1'-0"+1'-0"+3'-0"+3'-0" for Grid 3, 4'-0"+13'-0"+3'-1" for Grid 6) that appear nowhere on the sheet, binds 3'-7" and 5'-0" to the wrong details, and assigns W8X13 to the floor beam near Grid 5 when that beam is W10X15. Set B keeps the section designations correct (W10X15 floor beams, W8X13 roof beam at grids 2,3,4,5) and correctly reports the 2" opening edge offsets, 10"/8" opening widths and 3" opening diameter, though it also mis-binds detail labels (A4/B4) and reads the 2" edge offset as opening height. Both repeat the unsupported 2" bottom offset at Detail E6 and mislabel the 6" opening height as a beam width, and both truncate the entity "ROOF BEAM @ GR" while attaching 4'-2" (a floor-beam dimension) to it. Set B has fewer fabricated or misbound values overall, so it is the better set.
